''R6'' - BelowNatural |rarity = {{Color|Common}} |looped = Yes |music = No |moveable = Yes |interactable = No |oldmusic = '''Original Music''' [[File:Tower Defense Simulator OST - Russian|thumb|center|250px]] }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|Dance with me comrade!|Inventory Description}} {{QuoteBox|Crazy man...|Former Store Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Russian''' is an [[Emotes|emote]] that could have been bought in the store for {{Coins|650}}. It was made by [https://www.roblox.com/users/16983447/profile BelowNatural]. The emote is looped and no music can be heard while performing the emote. You can move while performing this emote. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Animations}} RussianNew.gif|Second version (13 October 2019 – 29 October 2020) Russian.gif|First version (19 July 2019 – 13 October 2019) }} ==Trivia== *This was one of the first [[emotes]] to be added to the game. *This was obtainable for free via the [[Codes|code]] ''LONGWAIT''. **This also made it the only emote that could be unlocked through a [[Codes|code]]. *This emote is based on the [https://wiki.teamfortress.com/wiki/Kazotsky_Kick Kazotsky Kick] taunt from ''Team Fortress 2''. **The music that used to play for this emote is also based on the music for the ''Team Fortress 2'' taunt. **The current and second version of the emote has the player clap their hands together during the emote, which is specific to the ''Heavy'''s version of the [https://wiki.teamfortress.com/wiki/Kazotsky_Kick Kazotsky Kick]. *Before the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]], this was one of the few emotes not to use the noob or grey skin as the icon. **The skin was red, possibly to reference communism as the Kazotsky Kick is a Slavic dance known as the "Kazachok". *This emote was taken offsale in the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]]. **However, those who had the emote before the update can still use it. ==Update History== *'''19 July 2019''' - [[BETA v1.6|BETA v1.6.0]] **'''Russian''' added. *'''27 July 2019''' - [[BETA v1.6|BETA v1.6.2]] **Code expired and added to the store. *'''13 October 2019''' - [[Release v1.0|Release v1.0.0]] **Animation replaced. **Music added. *'''9 November 2019''' - [[Release v1.2|Release v1.2.0]] **Music removed. *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **Animation replaced. **'''Russian''' is no longer obtainable. ==Notes== {{EmoteNavBox}}
